about: Targets resume_point@vN must reach on room_signals_golden.json: resume_open_accuracy, resume_topic_hit_rate (topic keywords and the reason), resume_cut_off_accuracy, quote_verbatim_rate and leak_free (both 1.0). Not measured yet: the coordinator's live run (EVAL_LIVE=1 EVAL_RECORD=1 uv run pytest -m eval tests/test_room_signals_eval.py -k live -s) records the answers and fills in the measured values; until then only the offline replay of the simulated recordings gates.
